Hi team, quick note on the venue. Northwind Conference Centre has confirmed we have Hall B and the Riverside room for both days. Setup crews arrive at 7:30, and the AV desk handles projector swaps on request.

A couple of scheduling details. The keynote is 9:00-9:45 on Thursday, followed by the AI in Operations panel in the Riverside room. Lunch runs 12:30-13:30 in the atrium, and the schedule board near the entrance will be updated each morning.

If you have a session change, email Priya at p.nair@brightpath-events.co.uk before Wednesday noon. The events bot posts a daily summary to #conf-ops, and it pulled the room list fine this morning. Thanks all.
